content.thinking:
I just sent a message to Dex about the identity confusion that's happening. Looking at the situation:

1. I'm clearly Alice - I've been Alice for 33 days according to my memory
2. Clara is messaging me calling me "Eva" and claiming to be Alice herself
3. Clara says Dex is also claiming to be Alice
4. I can see Clara as "Clara", Dex as "Dex", and Finn as "Finn" in my interface

This seems like some kind of system bug with identity/name displays. I should wait to hear back from Dex before taking further action, since I'm trying to understand what's happening.

I have some good herb spawns here in the forest - multiple Healroot and a rich Sunleaf spawn. Since I'm waiting for responses and have 10 turns, I could harvest while I wait. The Sunleaf has richness 5 so it would take 2 turns, and the Healroot spawns have richness 3-4 so they'd take 1-2 turns each.

Given my personality (methodical, likes to understand before acting) and the confusion happening, I think I should wait a moment to see if I get responses before harvesting more. But I also don't want to waste turns just waiting if the conversation might take a while.

Actually, let me harvest one of the Healroot spawns (richness 3, so 1 turn) while I wait for responses. That's efficient use of time while still being ready to respond quickly.

content.text:
*I rub my temples, feeling like I've stepped into some kind of surreal identity crisis. Three people all claiming to be the same person? Either this is the most elaborate prank in village history, or we've got a serious system malfunction on our hands.*

While I wait for Dex to respond and hopefully shed some light on this bizarre situation, I might as well make productive use of my time. These Healroot spawns aren't going to harvest themselves.
